title: Levodopa-carbidopa combination therapy in Parkinson disease
text: Levodopa is converted to dopamine in the central nervous system, restoring dopaminergic neurotransmission diminished by nigrostriatal degeneration in Parkinson disease. Co-administration with carbidopa, a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor, reduces peripheral conversion of levodopa and associated side effects.
